blockers: At native 1x the face collapses into a blown-out white and cyan horizontal feature beneath a dark rounded cap. Eye, nose, mouth, and facial plane structure are not readable, producing a mannequin or featureless faceplate artifact.

The silhouette is an almost symmetrical vertical stick with parallel legs, a rigid torso, and evenly balanced shoulders. The rapier is carrying most of the identity, while the body itself remains generic.

Midnight navy, obsidian, charcoal, and black garment masses merge on the dark inspection background. The high collar, corset, sleeves, pelvis, and trouser divisions do not separate reliably at native scale.
The idle strip is effectively frozen. The restrained intent has become negligible breathing, balance shift, and material response, with no convincing contained life.

The locomotion cycles read as limb substitutions rather than weight-bearing steps. The pelvis and torso remain rigid, hip and shoulder counter-rotation is weak, and the legs show little compression, extension, or planted-contact logic.

Foot alignment to the red baseline is technically stable, but the boots read as narrow dark sticks ending in tiny blocks. Heel-to-toe contact, pressure, and clear support-foot changes are not visually convincing.

The signature gesture is driven almost entirely by the arm and rapier. It lacks a readable anticipation, torso counter-lean, weight transfer, blade-tip lag, and settle, so it does not yet function as a character-specific gesture at 1x.
Secondary motion is absent or too small to register: the rapier behaves as a rigid attached line, while hair, sleeves, coat or skirt edges, and other delayed masses provide no layered follow-through.
high_value_changes: Re-author the head at native 1x: reduce the white bloom, enlarge and clarify the hair mass, establish a readable face or intentional mask design, and reserve distinct pixels for the primary facial feature.
Create a stronger material value hierarchy: separate hair from obsidian cloth, corset from torso, sleeves from gloves, and trousers from the background before adding fine brass highlights.

Redesign the canonical silhouette around a deliberately offset fencing stance: establish a clear weight-bearing leg, asymmetrical shoulder and hip line, readable sword hand, and a more specific lower-body contour.

Rebuild the walk cycles from contact, passing, and recoil keys with visible pelvis translation, knee compression, shoulder counter-rotation, and heel-to-toe foot action. Baseline alignment alone is not sufficient.
Restructure the signature gesture into a controlled three-beat action: small anticipation, committed rapier raise with torso participation, then a held pose and delayed settle.
Add restrained but measurable secondary motion to the sword tip, hair, sleeves, and coat or skirt edges so the character remains deliberate without appearing mechanically frozen.
Validate every direction at native 1x on both dark and light backgrounds, especially profile and rear views where the face, corset, and hair identity currently disappear.
optional_notes: The 115.8px standing height and 0.0px ground-anchor drift satisfy the stated technical limits, but they do not compensate for weak native-scale readability.
The brass shoulder accents and rapier provide usable role cues, but they currently function as isolated highlights rather than an integrated character-specific design.
Do not use additional blur, bloom, or subpixel smoothing to solve the face and garment problems; the missing reads require pixel-level shape and value redesign.
No previous-round visual baseline was included, so regression clearance for facial readability, motion weight, and directional consistency is unverified.
regressions_from_previous: Round-05 comparison material was not supplied; regressions cannot be conclusively measured from the provided package.
strongest_improvements: Technical anchoring is fully stable: the candidate remains at the required bottom-center anchor with 0.0px drift.
The candidate includes complete eight-direction locomotion coverage and a dedicated signature gesture set.
The vertical proportion, navy-and-brass palette concept, and rapier placement establish the intended restrained duelist direction, even though they do not yet survive native-scale scrutiny.
luna_evaluation.single_most_important_next_change: Re-author one canonical standing and gesture key at native 1x before touching further animation polish: make the face readable, separate the navy garment masses, and replace the symmetric stick silhouette with a planted, asymmetrical fencing stance; then propagate that corrected design through all directions and frames.
